title.zh: NBA与CFTC签署预测市场监管协议，Kalshi和Polymarket成首选合作平台
title.en: NBA与CFTC签署预测市场监管协议，Kalshi和Polymarket成首选合作平台

current_state.zh: The CFTC and the NBA signed a memorandum of understanding to share information and coordinate on preventing insider trading and manipulation in prediction markets, with the NBA designating Kalshi and Polymarket as its preferred prediction-market platforms while state-versus-federal jurisdiction over such contracts remains contested.
current_state.en: The CFTC and the NBA signed a memorandum of understanding to share information and coordinate on preventing insider trading and manipulation in prediction markets, with the NBA designating Kalshi and Polymarket as its preferred prediction-market platforms while state-versus-federal jurisdiction over such contracts remains contested.
